title: Margin-scheme invoices (configurable tax presentation): VAT included and not shown, editable legal wording with presets, margin cost per invoice, and a margin report that says when inputs are missing
goal: An agency that sells packages under the travel agents' margin scheme can switch it on, choose or edit the legal mention, issue invoices without a VAT line, and give its accountant a report of margins and (when it has entered its rate and costs exist) VAT on the margin.
why: Gap 6 and the owner's 'keep it configurable'. Today the only option is 'None' plus a sentence in the payment terms. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.5 and 12. No tax rate is invented and no wording is applied silently.

edit: backend/src/routes/invoices.ts (create/update fields and the PDF totals block only)
backend/src/routes/settings.ts (margin_scheme key and the tax_system enum only)
desktop/src/app/(app)/invoices/** (regime select, margin cost field, preview)

steps: 0062: invoices ADD margin_cost, margin_cost_source, margin_vat_rate, margin_wording; schema; bundle.

tax-calculator.ts: TaxRegime gains 'margin'; computeInvoiceTax for margin returns no visible tax lines, total_tax 0, total = price, tax_notes = wording, tax_breakdown with one hidden MARGIN_VAT entry {base: margin, rate, amount} only when cost and rate are known, else {status: 'inputs_missing'}; credit notes freeze it (FrozenTaxRules).

margin-scheme.ts: costFor(invoice) per design section 12 (booking: departure per-seat costs x seats + per-departure costs / confirmed seats; else itinerary total_cost; else manual), snapshot on create, editable while draft; vatOnMargin(margin, rate) = margin x rate / (100 + rate) rounded in minor units.
Settings: margin_scheme key (design 4.5) with GET/PUT; tax_system and default_tax_type enums gain 'margin'; booking invoices start in margin mode when defaultFor says so.
Invoice create/edit accepts tax_regime margin (only when margin_scheme.enabled and the feature is on) and margin_cost when costSource is manual.
PDF: no VAT line and no buyer VAT number in margin mode; the wording printed under the totals.

Invoice defaults Tax card: 'Margin scheme (travel agents)' option; wording textarea with preset buttons (EU generic 'Margin scheme — Travel agents', Netherlands 'Bijzondere regeling reisbureaus', UK Tour Operators' Margin Scheme text) each labelled 'check with your accountant'; the agency's VAT rate field with no default and the hint that the report needs it; cost source.
Invoice page: the regime shown; in margin mode the cost and margin are visible to staff with finance rights only (never on the PDF).

financial-reports.ts: margin_scheme_report per design section 12 (rows per margin invoice; VAT blank without a rate; 'Costs not recorded' rows; totals over complete rows with the count of incomplete; banner text 'For your accountant: figures are computed from the costs recorded in TravelCRM'); tax_report excludes margin invoices from taxes invoiced and returns a pointer row.

tests: backend/test/margin-scheme.test.ts: margin invoice totals and hidden breakdown with and without cost or rate; booking invoice cost from departure costs; itinerary cost; manual cost; credit note keeps margin; PDF text has the wording and no VAT line; report rows complete and incomplete; feature off or setting off -> the regime is refused 400.
backend/test/tax-regimes.test.ts: existing golden invoices unchanged; a margin golden invoice added.
desktop vitest: lib/margin-scheme.ts (preview of margin and VAT on margin).

e2e/margin-scheme.spec.ts: enable the margin scheme with the EU preset and a rate, issue an invoice for a booking, the invoice shows no VAT line and the wording, the margin report lists it with VAT on the margin; without a rate the VAT column is blank.
acceptance: Margin-scheme invoices print the agency's wording and no VAT line; nothing is computed from an invented rate.
Agencies that do not enable it see the same invoices and reports as before (golden tests).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # 0 failed files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/margin-scheme.spec.ts e2e/invoices.spec.ts e2e/credit-debit-notes.spec.ts e2e/reports.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: margin_scheme (all plans) plus the agency setting margin_scheme.enabled.
Do not invent tax rates; presets are suggestions the agency must choose and may edit; every preset says to check with an accountant.
Backend: tenant migration 0062 only; regenerate the bundle; money in minor units as the tax engine does.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; t() with en and nl keys in margin.json and invoices.json; RTL-safe classes; money through lib/format.ts.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 4.5 and 12, services/tax-calculator.ts (R201), backend/test/tax-regimes.test.ts, services/domain/invoices.ts (R142).
R153 runs in parallel and owns the leads route and pages.
goLiveVerify: An accountant in the first EU market confirms the wording and the report before an agency relies on it.
